# Daily K9 Academy

> Owner-trained service dog training (psychiatric, autism, medical alert and response,
> mobility) and in-home obedience in Goodyear and greater Maricopa County, Arizona.
> Handler first, dog second - clients train the dog they already own into a
> public-access team through a one-on-one apprenticeship, rather than buying a
> program-placed dog.

Daily K9 Academy LLC is run by Nicole VanCleave, an ASCT Certified Instructor who
owner-trained her own psychiatric service dog, Bruce. Services are one-on-one and
delivered in-home and in public-access settings across the Phoenix West Valley and
greater Maricopa County: Goodyear, Avondale, Phoenix, Glendale, Peoria, Surprise,
Scottsdale, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe, Queen Creek.

- Service dog teams: owner-trained psychiatric (including PTSD), autism, medical alert
  and response, and mobility service dogs, typically $4,000–$9,000 over
  12–24 months (versus $20,000–$40,000 for a program-placed dog).
- Also offered: everyday pet obedience, and limited board-and-train.
- Not trained: guide dogs for blindness, hearing dogs.
- Not offered: service dog registration or certification documents (no such registry is
  legally recognized in the United States), veterinary services, or retail sales.
- Contact: (480) 712-2772 · nv@dailyk9.com

- [Types of service dogs](https://dailyk9.com/types-of-service-dogs): Psychiatric, PTSD, autism, medical alert and response, and mobility service dogs - the tasks each one does and what doesn't count.
- [Pricing](https://dailyk9.com/pricing): Published prices for every service, with no quote required.
- [Book a free intake call](https://dailyk9.com/start): The starting point for new clients - a free call to assess the dog and the handler's goals.
- [Client reviews](https://dailyk9.com/reviews): Reviews from Daily K9 Academy training clients, and where to leave one.

## Guides

- [Service dog training cost in Arizona (2026)](https://dailyk9.com/service-dog-training-cost-arizona): Itemized cost of owner-training versus a program placement, line by line.
- [How to get a psychiatric service dog in Arizona](https://dailyk9.com/how-to-get-a-psychiatric-service-dog-in-arizona): Qualifying under the ADA, choosing a dog, training tasks, and how to spot registry scams.
- [Psychiatric service dog tasks: 8 trained behaviors](https://dailyk9.com/psychiatric-service-dog-tasks): What a PSD actually does - deep pressure, grounding, blocking, room search, nightmare interruption - and how a task differs from an ESA.
- [Owner-trained vs. program-placed service dogs](https://dailyk9.com/owner-trained-vs-program-trained-service-dog): An honest comparison of cost, wait time, and control - including when a placement is the better choice.
